bug_info.bug_desc: In the SFENCE.VMA decoding logic under the SYSTEM opcode, the default case for the immediate field checks bits [31:25] for the pattern 7'b1001 to identify SFENCE.VMA. However, when this pattern does not match, there is no else branch to set illegal_instr. Consequently, any instruction with opcode SYSTEM, funct3=3'b000, rs1=0, rd=0, and an immediate value not matching ECALL/EBREAK/SRET/MRET/DRET/WFI/SFENCE.VMA will be decoded as a valid instruction instead of being flagged as illegal.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add an else branch in the default case of the immediate field decoding for SYSTEM opcode (funct3=3'b000) to set illegal_instr = 1'b1 when instr.instr[31:25] != 7'b1001, ensuring that unrecognized immediate encodings are properly trapped as illegal instructions.

bug_info.bug_desc: The FENCE.I decode branch marks the instruction illegal when bits [31:20] are nonzero. Those fields are reserved for future extensions and base implementations must ignore them, so legal FENCE.I encodings can raise an illegal-instruction exception.
bug_info.fix_hint: Remove the FENCE.I-specific nonzero immediate check and decode the instruction from its opcode and funct3 while ignoring the reserved rs1, rd, and immediate fields.
